evidenceBoundary: Public primary documentation only. Homepage links establish the documentation relationship; the migration guide explicitly identifies v2.dreamgen.com. No account, inference call, purchase, browser automation, production access, or device testing. Benefits are reviewer inferences. Documented means described by the publisher, not tested. Unknown means not established, not absent.

tradeoffs.note: Truncation and over-pinning warning; no lossless-memory claim.
Hidden and Excluded interactions separate reader-visible content from AI-visible content.
Sequel summary fidelity untested; original synchronization remains forthcoming in this guide.

unknowns.note: Raw prompt inspection, BYOK/local endpoints, full text sampler controls, and application self-hosting were not established.
No device tests, export round-trip test, or failure/input-retention test.
External-card compatibility unverified. Both public routes returned HTTP 500 through the fetch tool; this does not establish a product outage.
Voice, TTS, dictation, and chat-linked image workflow not established.

reusablePatterns.proposal: Expose reusable-definition versus story-only edit scope.
Review a sequel recap against its source story before starting.
Directed retry actions beside expert controls, with preserved alternatives.
Explain openings before starting; keep optional world details optional.

doNotCopy: Silent prompt contributions without an inspection path.
Treating generated recaps as faithful archives.
Promising portability based only on a JSON file extension.
